top_findings.title: Not an MCP server — no MCP protocol, transport, or tool registration
top_findings.evidence: go.mod declares zero dependencies (no MCP SDK); main.go:425 Run() logs tool names and returns nil (main.go:451); main.go:466 select{} blocks serving nothing; 10 Handle* methods (main.go:42-422) are never registered or wired to any transport. CONFIRMED by second opinion.
top_findings.suggestion: Add an MCP SDK/stdio JSON-RPC loop, register the 10 Handle* methods as tools, and make Run() actually serve.

top_findings.title: Test gate fails: 30 of 32 tests fail on a hardcoded relative data path
top_findings.evidence: test_coverage=0.045. All 32 tests call NewDataLoader("data/kaggle"); go test ./... sets CWD to each package dir so the path resolves to data/data/kaggle and query/data/kaggle (absent); CSVs live at module-root data/kaggle. LoadAll() errors -> t.Fatalf. Only 2 pure-function tests pass. CONFIRMED.
top_findings.suggestion: Resolve the data dir relative to module root or via DATA_DIR, or use an absolute test path.

top_findings.title: Comprehensive test suite exists but does not execute
top_findings.evidence: 32 test functions across data/loader_test.go (14) and query/handler_test.go (18) cover the query capabilities, but 30 fail to run due to the relative data path; how_to_verify requires tests to execute (test_coverage=0.045). 0 skips.
top_findings.suggestion: Fix the data-path resolution so the suite runs; the assertions look sound.
